meta.description: Release Intel 'outreach' mission executor. Acks the dispatch immediately, then discovers radio/blog/DJ/curator contacts and runs an email campaign once MEDIA_CONTACT_DISCOVERY_API_KEY is connected (email delivery itself is already wired via the backend's RESEND/SENDGRID/SMTP config), and posts results to POST /api/release-intel/missions/:missionId/callback. Requires n8n env vars DATIAM_API_URL and DATIAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
